# ymfm

Aaron Giles's emulator of the Yamaha FM chips, BSD 3-Clause (see `LICENSE`),
from https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm at commit
81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a, unmodified. Only the files the OPL
family needs are copied. Gaius uses its YM3812 (OPL2), the chip on the Sound
Blaster the original game's `SBFM.ADV` driver programs (`audio/`).
